question: At standard temperature and pressure (STP), the value of temperature is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**0ºC**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **0ºC** is the standard temperature at **standard temperature and pressure** (STP).
 
• STP is a reference point used in science to specify a set of conditions for experimental measurements.
 
• At STP, the temperature is set to** 0ºC (273.15 K) and the pressure is set to 1 atmosphere (atm)**.</l
